items.title: 67619_Big Nick Nicholas oral history interview
items.q: there was a trumpet player named Youngblood who was very promising

ctx.x: Well, there was a guy named Rev on piano. He was the arranger. And, of course, Al McKibbon...I don't remember the other guys names. I remember Al McKibbon was on bass and

Kelly Martin on drums, Rev was on piano and there was a trumpet player named Youngblood who was very promising. All I know is his name was Youngblood. But the other fellows, I can't remember who they were.
How large a group was it?
